preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of queries is between 1 and 10^5.
The value of A[v] is between 1 and 10^9.
The vertex v is between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: Output the sum of vis[u] for all u in the subtree of v, mod 10^9+7 for each query of type 2.
postconditions.description: The output for each query of type 2 is the sum of vis[u] for all u in the subtree of v, modulo 10^9+7.
